protocol_gate.joint_win: C preferred over BOTH OFF and D in the same case (slight counts); no source-confirmed factual error providing the apparent advantage.
protocol_gate.loss_check: Number of joint wins must exceed number of cases C is judged worse than OFF. Report every loss and material source misuse separately.
protocol_gate.pass: Only proceed to a scoped deployable path/latency and feedback study; not a population claim, qualified scalar reward or automatic PPO start.
protocol_gate.fail: Stop expanding G tuning/global retrieval/positive-example search for this task under this protocol; report bounded evidence and develop avoidance/latency findings with fixed STOP baseline. No claim contextual RL beats STOP.
protocol_gate.technical_or_rating_insufficiency: Report inconclusive/coverage limits; no replacement cases or automatic expansion.

sensitivity_note: 8 cases are coverage-incomplete, not a new study. No imputation, substitution or additional questions.
source_error_rule: No source-confirmed error supplying either observed joint advantage in the pre-answer content audit; no positive case excluded.
